title: pvLSDynaReader
body:
## pvLSDynaReader

Reads an LS-DYNA d3plot database (the d3plot file and its numbered family files d3plot01, d3plot02… holding later states) as a time series. The output is a multiblock dataset with one unstructured-grid block per selected part, named after the part, carrying nodal arrays (e.g. Velocity, Acceleration) and per-element-type cell arrays (e.g. Stress, EffPlastStrn). Use it for crash, forming and impact results; select parts and arrays to limit memory.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The mesh is deformed only when "Deflected Coordinates" is among PointArrays and DeformedMesh is true; the reader then also adds a Deflection displacement array.
- Eroded elements are removed by default (RemoveDeletedCells), so cell counts change over time.
- VTK notes that rigid-body and road-surface support is incomplete.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `LSDynaReader`. Identity: `sources/LSDynaReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BeamArrays` | Select which beam arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `DeformedMesh` | When true, the output point coordinates are replaced by the deflected (current) coordinates at each time step, so the mesh moves with the solution; when false the mesh stays in its original position. This only works when the nodal array "Deflected Coordinates" is selected in PointArrays; the reader then also adds a "Deflection" displacement array either way. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | Set the file name for the LSDyna reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PartArrays` | Select which part arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ParticleArrays` | Select which particle arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrays` | Select which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RemoveDeletedCells` | Should cells that have been deleted (failed structurally, for example) be removed from the mesh? | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `RigidBodyArrays` | Select which rigid body arrays to load. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RoadSurfaceArrays` | Select which road surface arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ShellArrays` | Select which shell arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SolidArrays` | Select which solid arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ThickShellArrays` | Select which thick shell arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvLSDynaReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
